_README: Staging bank for keep/cut review. NOT loaded by the app. 10 distinct categories; target ~20 questions each (a pool). At game start the board draws 5 (one per value tier) from each selected category, randomly. `subcategory` (optional) tags a question within a category; Movies & TV uses Movie/TV/Anime so you can filter at setup. `note` shows source/confidence: WEB-VERIFIED = checked live; Confident = within knowledge window; docx = from your Trivia Questions doc; NotebookLM = your researched batch; VERIFY = I still need to confirm this. Difficulty = clue specificity (tells at the bottom, bare at the top); final calibration happens at merge.
